name: cocos-ai-toolkit
description: Project-independent, reversible Cocos UI reference tools for AI

scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json && tsc -p tsconfig.runtime.json --module System --outDir dist/preview-system
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.qualify:editor: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-editor-qualification.mjs && node scripts/qualify-editor.mjs
scripts.qualify:source: npm run build && node scripts/qualify-source.mjs && node scripts/verify-p4-mcp.mjs
